# Pull Request Checklist

## Summary

Describe the change and why it was made.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] (if touching social publishing/publication paths) manual verification for safety gates

## Risk and rollback

List potential regressions and how to rollback.
